fact_findings.hyperscaler_options: RISE with SAP runs on a customer-chosen hyperscaler: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud; IBM Cloud is now also a full hyperscaler option for RISE. Azure has widest BTP service coverage and is SAP's commercial default in many regions; AWS/GCP require explicit negotiation. Commercial differences: pricing structure, BTP service availability, EDP mechanics, data residency coverage. VERIFY current hyperscaler list + Indonesia region availability (AWS Asia Pacific/Jakarta ap-southeast-3; Google Cloud Jakarta asia-southeast2; Azure Indonesia Central status) via SAP + hyperscaler docs. Note: Huawei Cloud is a Soltius technology partner but is NOT an official RISE hyperscaler — do not conflate.
fact_findings.ecc_maintenance: SAP ECC 6 / Business Suite 7 mainstream maintenance ends 31 Dec 2027; extended maintenance available through 31 Dec 2030 for +2 percentage points on the maintenance fee. After that, Customer-Specific Maintenance (no regular/legal updates, limited fixes). Q1 2025 SAP announced 'SAP ERP, private edition, transition option' — a RISE package letting select complex customers run ECC in SAP-managed private cloud through 2031-2033; prerequisites include signing a RISE cloud subscription and moving to HANA DB before end of 2030. VERIFY all dates + program name against support.sap.com and news.sap.com (dates have shifted historically).
fact_findings.integration: S/4HANA transformations surface integration as a top delivery risk; ECC-era interfaces often can't carry forward unchanged. SAP Integration Suite (a core BTP service) is SAP's successor to PI/PO (Process Integration/Orchestration), offering cloud-native iFlows, API Management, pre-built connectors, event-driven messaging. Cutover is the moment to redesign point-to-point interfaces as API-led, Clean-Core-aligned integrations. VERIFY Integration Suite positioning + PI/PO end-of-maintenance; Indonesian localization interfaces (Coretax DJP live 2025, e-Faktur, bank host-to-host).
fact_findings.testing: Mock migration cycles run in sandbox with automated data-validation, functional-regression, and custom-code validation, typically 3-5 times before a dress rehearsal / mock cutover in a production-mirror environment (with performance testing). Test types: unit, SIT (system integration test), regression (finance, procurement, inventory, HR), UAT with line-of-business experts from Fit-to-Standard workshops. SAP Cloud ALM Test Management documents formal end-to-end tests. Test data must be realistic, versioned, scenario-specific. VERIFY SAP Cloud ALM Test Management naming/scope.
fact_findings.governance: ERP failures often trace to unclear responsibility: Customer, SAP, and Partner each assume someone else owns approvals, testing, incident response, upgrades, change management. A steering committee provides strategic oversight (goal alignment, milestone sign-off, escalation). RACI matrices (per SAP Activate deliverable) clarify who is Responsible/Accountable/Consulted/Informed across Customer/SAP/Partner. Scope changes flow through change-request control. VERIFY SAP Activate phases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run) + quality-gate concept.
